title: Dżamilla Tymińska
description: A dynamic, responsive React portfolio powered by Firebase, featuring a built-in admin panel for live customization—change fonts, backgrounds, and text styling; add, edit, or remove works; includes handcrafted two-layer sliders and background images that react to mouse movement—all without touching code.
keyFeatures: Using Firebase, the admin can update photos, titles, descriptions, fonts, text styles, and overall styling—changes are saved instantly and reflected in real time.
Users can add, edit, or delete works and entire site sections entirely from the browser—no need to touch code.
A handcrafted slider splits text into two lines. As new content is added, rows dynamically appear to the right, creating a clean, engaging scrolling effect.
The site is built with React and adapts smoothly to all device sizes—from mobile phones to high-resolution desktops.
Background images respond subtly to mouse movement, adding a layer of interactive depth and visual appeal.

title: Flower lover
description: This is a modern, responsive React-powered flower shop interface featuring a multi-criteria product filter. Users can refine selections by category, color, price, or occasion—and even apply multiple filters at once for precise results. The sleek design and immediate, client-side filtering create a seamless shopping experience.
keyFeatures: Built with React for a modern, responsive interface that adapts seamlessly to all devices.
Multi-criteria filtering system—refine products by category, color, price, or occasion.
Supports applying multiple filters at once for precise and flexible product discovery.
Instant, client-side filtering ensures smooth performance without page reloads.
Clean, elegant design optimized for a seamless and enjoyable shopping experience.

title: Małgorzata Porażewska
description: A fully customizable portfolio powered by Firebase, featuring an admin panel for real-time edits. Easily change fonts, colors, text styles, and backgrounds, as well as add, edit, or remove works and entire site sections—no code required, all directly from the browser.
keyFeatures: Powered by Firebase with an integrated admin panel for real-time edits and updates.
Easily customize fonts, colors, text styles, and backgrounds directly from the browser—no coding required.
Add, edit, or remove works and entire site sections with instant, seamless publishing.
Fully responsive layout that adapts smoothly across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.
Clean, modern design that highlights creative work while staying easy to maintain.

title: Explore Indonesia
description: Responsive React + TypeScript website with a dynamic slider, interactive gallery, and adaptive YouTube video embeds. Features a modern burger menu on small screens, ensuring smooth navigation and a seamless user experience across all devices.
keyFeatures: Developed with React and TypeScript for scalable, maintainable, and high-performance code.
Fully responsive design that ensures a seamless experience across all devices and screen sizes.
Dynamic slider and interactive gallery to showcase content in an engaging, user-friendly way.
Embedded YouTube videos adapt automatically to screen size while preserving correct proportions.
Modern burger menu enhances navigation on smaller screens with a clean, intuitive interface.

title: YourMeal
description: A flexible restaurant delivery website built with plain JavaScript and a connected database. It features intuitive product cards, an instantly updating shopping cart, and quick category filtering.
keyFeatures: Built with plain JavaScript and a connected database for fast performance and reliable data handling.
Responsive design that adapts smoothly to mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.
Intuitive product cards display images, descriptions, and prices for a clear shopping experience.
Instantly updating shopping cart keeps users informed in real time without page reloads.
Quick category filtering allows users to find dishes by type, price, or tags efficiently.
